rows.note: Use this for a person, child, or market that is lively, vigorous, or active; it is the all-purpose choice when active means energetic or lively.

example.english: This child is very active on the sports field.
example.traditional: 呢個細路仔喺球場上好活躍。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 hou2 wut6 joek3

rows.note: Use this when active means energetically taking action or applying oneself, rather than simply moving around.

example.english: They are always active in volunteering.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 ji6 gung1 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 zik1 gik6

rows.note: Use this for an active agent or active voice contrasted with something passive or merely receptive.

example.english: They took the active role in contacting the clients this time.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 keoi5 zyu2 dung6 lyun4 lok3 haak3 wu6

rows.note: Use this mainly for a law, rule, or system that is currently in force rather than merely proposed or obsolete.

example.english: This law is currently active, not just a proposal.
example.traditional: 呢條係現行法例，唔係新建議。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hai6 jin6 haang4 faat3 lai6 m4 hai6 san1 gin3 ji5
